# mtncloud_group (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud group data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_group" "mtncloudgroup" {
  name = "MTN Cloud"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud group.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Optional code for use with policies
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `location` (String) Optional location argument for your group
